jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline At least 5–7 years of relevant experience in an Engineering or Operations environment, including project management and NPI activities through the Product Life Cycle Deep understanding of NPI processes, production readiness, manufacturing operations, supply chain planning, sourcing/contract manufacturers or OEMs, supplier quality, and operational implementation
